name: meta-orch
description: Meta-orchestration layer above /agent-orch:make for coordinating MANY parallel Claude Code sessions against HUGE multi-epic work (1→35 epics, 5→1000+ stories) using GitHub Issues on code.ssnc.dev as the shared state store. Four skills form a pipeline. (1) /design-tech-spec — staff/principal-level technical-specification design for something huge: runs /deep-research when available and a relentless grill-me-style Socratic interrogation (one question at a time, recommended answer supplied, explore-the-codebase-over-asking) that considers the existing codebase, all source, and a team-work /wiki if initialized, then writes docs/tech-specs/000N-name.md. (2) /design-tech-plan — decomposes an approved spec into epics→stories, computes tranches + gates (what can safely run in parallel vs. what would merge-conflict), CREATES every GitHub epic/story issue via gh (epics can be epics-of-epics), embeds a ready-to-run /make-session prompt in each story issue, and records the whole plan in docs/tech-plan/000N-name.md. (3) /make-session — the ONLY worker skill and the sole owner of GitHub story/epic state for a session: on start it prints a HUGE RED 'do not start another /make-session yet' warning, finds an open + gate-open story (scoped to an epic if one is passed, else across epics), asks the user to confirm the pick, atomically LOCKS the issue via a GitHub Actions concurrency lock the instant they confirm, then flips to a GREEN 'you may start another /make-session now', pulls .meta-orch/session-guardrails.md into context, and hands the full prompt + guardrails to /agent-orch:make — emitting a heartbeat entirely from make-session + the guardrails (agent-orch is never modified). (4) /coordinate-session — a coordinator that loops every N minutes (configurable, default 5) reading in-progress issues + heartbeat labels, checking out each session's worktree to read its STATUS.md, and reporting per-epic/per-story status: who is working on what, how it is going, and what is open-gated to run. Config lives in .meta-orch/config.md (session count default 5, loop interval, labels, lock workflow) and the operating contract in .meta-orch/session-guardrails.md; both are auto-provisioned from plugin assets on first run. Concept guide: docs/meta-orch.md. Designed for a team of N engineers each running 3–7 sessions across multiple epics with a single coordinator, with no changes to the agent-orch plugin.
